claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the brushes as soft and good quality, often noting they feel gentle on the skin.
Many reviewers praise the value and quantity for the price, calling the set a steal or worth it.
Several reviewers mention a strong factory or paint-like smell, though some note it fades after airing out or washing.
A number of reviewers report the brushes falling apart or breaking, sometimes within weeks or months of use.
Reviewers appreciate the included carrying case, describing it as nice, well-organized, and good for travel.
